32" IPS QHD Entertainment Monitor

Design features such as an ultra-slim profile, metallic silver triangle stand, and a sleek edge-to-edge frameless bezel give the monitor a premium feel that fits nicely both at home and in the office. VX3276-2K-mhd-2 leverages SuperClear® IPS panel and rich 10-bit color to produce an extensive array of vibrant colors with wide viewing angles. What's more, this monitor is integrated with dual 2-watt sterop speakers, while DisplayPort, Mini DP, and 2 HDMI ports offer flexible connectivity options for both general usage and gaming.

This monitor takes on an architecturally inspired design aesthetic fused with modern form factors such as an ultra-slim profile, modern frameless bezel, and a unique triangle stand.

QHD Resolution

With Adaptive Sync technology, screen tearing and choppy frame rates are eliminated to provide seamless and smooth visuals in every scene.

Adaptive Sync 

HDR10 Delivers Stellar Contrast and Color Accuracy

This monitor is compatible with the industry standard HDR10 high dynamic range, so color, brightness, and contrast are more defined and exceed the capabilities of ordinary monitors.

HDR10 

Mega Dynamic Contrast

A mega dynamic contrast ratio of 80M:1 creates depth in images by adding more definition to the darkest and brightest colors on the screen to ensure images are shown with the finest details.

80M:1 DCR
